requirements.title: Software Design and Development
requirements.description: Collaborate with product managers and other developers to analyze user needs and design, build, and deploy new software programs and features.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has demonstrated experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence applications using React and Python/Flask, which aligns closely with the requirement to design and develop software.

requirements.title: Coding
requirements.description: Write clean, scalable, and efficient code using established development practices and conventions.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has proficiency in JavaScript/React and Python/Flask, indicating the ability to write clean and efficient code. The focus on maintainable code and technical documentation supports this requirement.

requirements.title: Testing and Debugging
requirements.description: Conduct unit and integration testing and perform debugging to ensure strong functionality, optimal performance, and security.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has a proven track record of troubleshooting complex issues and implementing testing and debugging, particularly with location filtering problems and RBAC system implementations.

requirements.title: Maintenance and Improvement
requirements.description: Maintain and improve the performance of existing software.
requirements.explanation: The candidate's experience in database management and optimization, as well as maintaining business intelligence applications, aligns well with the requirement for software maintenance and improvement.

wishes.title: Collaboration Skills
wishes.description: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
wishes.explanation: The candidate has collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams in their current role, although more specific examples of team collaboration could strengthen this match.
